visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens at Chidorigafuchi with white cherry blossoms framing the shot. Several blue and yellow rowboats are seen gliding on the green water of the moat. People are rowing, wearing casual spring attire. The background shows a stone wall and crowds of people on the bank. (2) Shifts to a night view of Shibuya Sakuragaoka. The street is lined with cherry trees illuminated with bright pink lights, creating a glowing tunnel. Pedestrians walk on the sidewalks, and cars pass through the street. (3) Daytime at Meguro River follows, featuring pink paper lanterns hanging alongside white cherry blossoms. The camera pans along the canal, showing the dense trees overhanging the water. (4) In Kudanshita, a white car drives down a street under a thick canopy of white blossoms. (5) Mitake Shrine is shown with its stone monument and torii gate surrounded by blooming trees. (6) At Sakurazaka, the view focuses on a red bridge crossing over a street lined with cherry blossoms. (7) A close-up of weeping cherry blossoms at Senso-ji Temple with the iconic red temple building in the background. (8) An overhead shot of Roppongi Midtown shows a curved road with blossoms and a black taxi. (9) Further shots show various locations like Roppongi Sakurazaka and Nadarezaka, featuring wooden signs and dense pink blossoms. (10) A train is seen passing behind a curtain of weeping blossoms at Iidabashi. (11) A person holds several pink cherry blossom petals in their palm. (12) At Musashino Reiwa Shrine, a person holds a pink commemorative sheet in front of a modern grey building and flower beds. (13) The final scenes show street views in Nihonbashi and colorful flower pairings at Kuramae Shrine.
